Hi, I am Xinyuan Huang, a postdoctoral researcher at the Andlinger Center for Energy and the Environment at Princeton University.

I work on modeling realistic global decarbonization pathways and assessing how regional variations affect investment in low-carbon technologies across countries. I also study how mitigation policies affect air pollution, health burdens, and health inequities under future uncertainties using integrated assessment models.

I received my PhD in Environmental Engineering from Penn State University. Prior to joining Penn State, I worked as a data scientist at SF Express, the largest logistics company in China.

## Research Interests

- Energy systems and integrated assessment modeling
- Air pollution and health impacts
- Environmental justice
- Realistic modeling of decarbonization
